svg.title: Food — Expanded list viewport
svg.desc: Observed S-FOOD-SHEET-EXPANDED from food-165435-list-sheet-expanded.png. Native editable labels, shapes and controls; genuine public logo crops and 15px map strip only are raster, converted to sRGB. Pointer/hover omitted. Fifth card and clipped tags match visible bounds. This is not the entire venue list or proof of continuous scrolling. Fonts/icons approximate.
